scenes.narration: Nap time. Forty minutes to work. And I haven't started.
scenes.notes: Look: cinematic live-action b-roll + magical motion graphics. Ground for graphics: near-black #040208. Accent: FOCO purple #A78BFA (the magic light), orange #FB923C for done/checks only. Visual thread: FROST. The real world freezes (desaturated, icy blue frost creeping in from the edges, only the clock moves) and FOCO's purple light melts it back to warm colour. One character: the same mom in a beige shirt in every shot (one Pexels shoot by Sarah Chai). ~30s. Hook: clip plays, a big clock reads 11:47, text 'Freelancer. 11:47 AM. Hasn't started.'

scenes.narration: I know exactly what to do. My brain just won't start.
scenes.notes: The hook clip holds on one frame; frost spreads from the edges, colour drains, floating thoughts drift and freeze: 47 unread emails / client is waiting / 5 more minutes on my phone. Only the clock keeps ticking.
A phone rises out of the frost with the real FOCO list; he taps Reply to important emails, Suggest AI splitting. The phone glows purple, the only warm thing in a frozen frame.

scenes.narration: It took the big scary task, and broke it into tiny steps.
scenes.notes: MAGIC: purple light bursts from the phone; a big card 'Reply to important emails' cracks and shatters into five small glowing step chips that float in the air: Open your email and check titles / Flag the 3 most urgent / Draft the first reply / Send quick responses / Close the email tab. Sparkles.

scenes.narration: Step one. Open my inbox. Two minutes. Okay. Just this one.
scenes.notes: The first chip glows, the others dim. The real focus screen: Open your email and check title, 2 min, Start Focus. On the press, a ring of purple light sweeps out and MELTS the frost: colour floods back.

scenes.narration: And then, I was just doing it.
scenes.notes: Warm, unfrozen. A floating FOCO focus timer beside the hands; step chips tick off with sparks.

scenes.narration: First step, done. Before the baby even woke up.
scenes.notes: Relief. A small FOCO 'You did it' card pops in the corner.

scenes.narration: Foco. The start button your brain is missing.
onScreenText: The start button your brain is missing.
scenes.notes: A glowing START button made of purple light, the FOCO icon and wordmark, the line, store badges.
